name: Absorb LMS
summary: Absorb LMS publishes no prices; its pricing page is a form that asks for learner count, from 1 to 50 up to 25,000 or more, and a salesperson replies. It auto-assigns training by role, region or regulation, shows course progress and completion, and builds custom reports through Absorb Analyze.

facts.text: The pricing request form asks how many learners you have, with tiers from 1 to 50 up to 25,000 or more, and shows no price figures.
The home page says compliance training is auto-assigned by role, region or regulation, and lets admins monitor course progress and completion.
The home page names ADP, Workday and Salesforce integrations plus more than 40 other systems, with an API and webhooks.
